feeds.title: Yorkie Universe
feeds.description: Welcome to Yorkie Universe, a site all about Yorkshire Terriers! We really love Yorkies and strive to give you the best information about the breed possible. You will find info about how to care for your Yorkie, health and training info, grooming, and products for your dog. I'm Cathy and I have adored Yorkshire Terriers since I was a child. I have lived with dogs all my life and have had many jobs working with them as a kennel worker, a dog groomer, a pet hotel clerk, and as a dog breeder. Now I just write about them and I'm a dog mom of 4 sweet pups.

feeds.title: Yorkie Passion Blog
feeds.description: I hope the informational articles will allow you to have a better understanding of the breed and their needs. I hope as well that Yorkie lovers can find a common place to share their experiences, photos, knowledge, and advice that will benefit their own Yorkies as well as many abandoned, abused and sick Yorkies that need all the help and support we can offer. Yorkies changed my life when I was recovering from my accident. My love for these wonderful animals is what has inspired me to have Yorkie Passion.

feeds.title: The Yorkie Times
feeds.description: The Yorkie Times shares awesome photos, articles, and videos about Yorkies to make you smile and share with your friends.

feeds.title: Miniature Yorkshire Terrier
feeds.description: This is a blog about Yorkies. I am a 4-pound miniature Yorkshire 'Yorkie' Terrier. I was born in Michigan and now divide my time jetsetting back and fourth from Michigan to Chicago, spending time on both 'coasts'.

feeds.title: Yorkies Are Us Blog
feeds.description: Here at Yorkies are us, we aim to provide you with helpful information on grooming, training, products, and everything else related to the Yorkshire Terrier.

feeds.title: Showsight » Yorkshire Terrier
feeds.description: Showsight Magazine - the world's most influential purebred dog publication since 1992. Each issue reaches a global audience dedicated to preserving the history and health of purpose-bred dogs. Filled with award-winning editorial focused on news and insights from the dog show community, top breeders, handlers, AKC Judges, and more! Learn everything you need about Yorkshire Terrier including training tips, food information and more!

feeds.title: Wendys Yorkies Blog
feeds.description: I am Wendy. My goal is to provide my puppies with excellent loving homes and for you to have the best possible experience with your new addition. Discover more about Yorkie, puppies up for adoption and sale, services, health and training tips and more!

feeds.title: Yyorkie
feeds.description: Yyorkie is your source for everything on Yorkshire dogs including health, personality, grooming tips, training, dog products and more!

feeds.title: Yorkie.Life Blog
feeds.description: Raising a Yorkie is not an easy task, and we always want the best for her. It takes a lot of patience, reading, and talking other Yorkie owners to train her & find the best food, toys, and groomers in town.
